name: Server Settings
description: Configure server hostname, port, startup boot service, power controls, and admin account password

commands.enable_boot_service_sudo:
mkdir -p /usr/local/bin && CUR_DIR="$(pwd)" && (go build -o /usr/local/bin/linnas "$CUR_DIR/main.go" 2>/dev/null || cp "$CUR_DIR/linnas" /usr/local/bin/linnas 2>/dev/null || cp /proc/self/exe /usr/local/bin/linnas) && chmod +x /usr/local/bin/linnas && printf '[Unit]
Description=LinNAS Web Control Panel
After=network.target network-online.target local-fs.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
WorkingDirectory=%s
StandardOutput=append:%s/autostart_debug.log
StandardError=append:%s/autostart_debug.log
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/linnas -a
Restart=always
RestartSec=3
User=root

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
' "$CUR_DIR" "$CUR_DIR" "$CUR_DIR" > /etc/systemd/system/linnas.service && chmod 644 /etc/systemd/system/linnas.service && systemctl daemon-reload && systemctl unmask linnas && systemctl enable --now linnas
commands.disable_boot_service_sudo: systemctl disable --now linnas || true; rm -f /etc/systemd/system/linnas.service /usr/local/bin/linnas; systemctl daemon-reload
